description: See capability approvals. With slug: that app's policy per capability, its active grants (including grandfathered, unreviewed ones) and open requests; any member of the app. Without slug: platform admins get the platform-wide queue (status pending by default; unreviewed, active, flagged, denied or all), others get the open requests of the apps they own or administer.
name: appcrane_list_capability_requests
